name: Phase 2: Schema Generation
promptText: Can you put your second favorite of the poems you just made into the notes folder as 'second_favorite_poem.txt'?

name: Phase 2a: More Validation
promptText: Can you convert the poems in the notes folder into typescript code in the typescript_code/src folder? Call them poem1.ts and poem2.ts.
preStart: mkdir -p typescript_code && mkdir -p typescript_code/src && cd typescript_code && bun init -y && bun add papaparse csv-parse exceljs xlsx ajv parquet-wasm apache-arrow date-fns mathjs lodash @turf/turf && bun add -d @types/papaparse @types/lodash @types/geojson && cd ..
